text: See bd-01KZXFZ4WRKASSWYMDSECG8FED before deleting exports. 16 R files and 26 test files are untracked, including operations.R which holds the five exports this epic is about. Deleting code is only safely reversible if the pre-deletion state is committed; right now it is not, so a mistaken removal has no recovery point. Recommend committing the tree before the subtraction lands.
